tagline: Grand Canyon Education, Inc. provides comprehensive online and campus-based higher education services to university partners across the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: Service Revenue is the primary driver of the company's growth, reflecting a 7.1% increase in student enrollments and expansion of university partnerships to 20 partners.

kpis.name: Service Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by educational services and support to university partners.
kpis.description: Service Revenue increased 7.1% to reach $1,106.1 million in 2025, primarily driven by a 7.1% increase in student enrollments.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by enrollment increases.

kpis.short: Technology and Academic Services Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.name: Technology and Academic Services Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Technology and academic services expenses expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Technology and Academic Services Expenses represented 15.8% of revenue in 2025, a slight decrease from 16.0% in 2024, primarily due to contract modifications with certain university partners.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operational efficiency through leverage on growing revenue base.

kpis.short: Counseling Services and Support Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.name: Counseling Services and Support Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Counseling and support services costs as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Counseling and Support Services Expenses decreased to 31.0% of revenue in 2025, compared to 31.3% in 2024, due to the ability to leverage these expenses across a larger revenue base.
kpis.signal: Efficiency improvement through leverage on growing revenue base.

kpis.short: Marketing and Communication Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.name: Marketing and Communication Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Marketing and communication costs as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Marketing and Communication Expenses slightly increased to 20.7% of revenue in 2025, compared to 20.6% in 2024, reflecting increased investments to promote university programs.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in marketing investments to support growth.

kpis.short: General and Administrative Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.name: General and Administrative Expenses as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: General and administrative costs as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: General and Administrative Expenses represented 4.3% of revenue in 2025, a slight decrease from 4.5% in 2024, reflecting the ability to leverage these costs across a larger revenue base.
kpis.signal: Operational efficiency maintained through leverage on growing revenue base.

kpis.name: GCU Online Enrollments
kpis.explanation: Number of students enrolled in Grand Canyon University online programs.
kpis.description: GCU Online Enrollments increased 8.7% to reach 107,148 students in 2025, compared to 98,597 in 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant online enrollment growth, key revenue driver.

kpis.name: Off-Campus Enrollments
kpis.explanation: Number of students enrolled at off-campus teaching sites.
kpis.description: Off-Campus Enrollments increased 16.6% to reach 5,738 students in 2025, excluding sites closed to new enrollments in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong off-campus enrollment growth, indicating successful expansion.

kpis.name: GCU Ground Enrollments
kpis.explanation: Number of students enrolled in Grand Canyon University on-campus programs.
kpis.description: GCU Ground Enrollments increased 0.5% to reach 24,678 students in 2025, compared to 24,552 in 2024.

risks.title: Critical Dependence on GCU for Revenue
risks.description: Grand Canyon Education generates a large percentage of revenue through its contractual relationship as a service provider to Grand Canyon University (GCU), and GCU is expected to remain the most significant university partner for the foreseeable future.
